settings.title: Send your wishlist
settings.text: Paste the links of the items you want, with sizes, colors and preferences. Everything stays saved on your account.

settings.title: I scout, you validate
settings.text: I go to the Paris outlets, send you real-time photos and prices of each item found. You validate before I buy — total control.

settings.title: We settle & ship
settings.text: Final payment after validation, then careful packing and tracked Colissimo delivery to your address — Europe & worldwide.
